selfbuild.title: Self-build
selfbuild.hint: Build Agentory from source so an agent can change it. Needs Rust, the MSVC build tools and git.
selfbuild.install.title: Install {tool}?
selfbuild.no_winget: winget was not found. Install the missing tools yourself, then check again.
selfbuild.enable.title: Enable self-build?
selfbuild.enable.message: Agentory will clone its source at {tag} into {dir} and run a first release build. The clone and the build cache use several GB of disk, and the first build can take a long time. It runs in the background.
selfbuild.status.building: Building (the first build takes a while)…
selfbuild.cache.clean.title: Clean the build cache?
selfbuild.cache.clean.message: This deletes {dir}. The next build starts from scratch and takes much longer.
selfbuild.upstream.current: You have the latest official release.
selfbuild.upstream.warn: If you changed the same areas as the release, merging may need conflict resolution by an agent, which takes time.
selfbuild.upstream.confirm.title: Merge {tag} into your build?
selfbuild.upstream.confirm.message: Agentory will merge {tag} into a copy of your branch and open an agent session. Conflicts are resolved by the agent. Nothing is installed until you review and apply it.
review.title: Review change
review.unavailable: This session has no worktree to apply.
review.flags.title: Review carefully
review.flags.body: This change touches code that decides whether a build is trusted. A weakened check would let a broken build through. Read these changes line by line before applying.
review.discard.title: Discard this change?
review.discard.body: This closes {name} and deletes its worktree and branch, including anything not applied. It cannot be undone.
review.restart.title: Restart Agentory?
review.restart.body: Agentory closes, installs the new build and starts it again. Running sessions end. If the new build fails to start, the previous one is restored.
review.status.conflict: Conflicts with your branch in: {files}. The session was asked to resolve them; apply again once it is done.
review.status.build_failed: The build failed. Your branch is unchanged.
review.status.tests_failed: The tests failed. Your branch is unchanged.
review.status.smoke_failed: The new build did not start correctly. Your branch is unchanged.
review.status.error: Could not apply: {error}. Your branch is unchanged.
review.status.ready: Built, tested and merged. Restart to install it.
review.no_changes: No changes against your branch yet.
